stories.title: Bank of Canada raises benchmark rate to 2.5%
stories.summary: The Bank of Canada increased its policy rate by a quarter‑point to 2.5 % on Oct 28, marking its first hike since 2023. Governor Tiff Macklem said the move is intended to reduce the risk that rising energy prices will broaden inflation, which was 3.1 % in September, largely driven by the Middle‑East conflict. The rate had been held at 2.25 % for seven consecutive meetings, and the next decision is set for Dec 9.

stories.summary: By Pratigya Vajpayee and Siddhi Nayak, Bloomberg Last Updated: Oct 28, 2026, 07:56:00 AM IST Indian banks have seen their excess funds drop significantly as the Reserve Bank of India maintains liquidity tightness. The central bank has provided limited liquidity support and capped assistance at 1.5 trillion rupees.

stories.title: Ceasefire extended to wider Kherson region
stories.summary: A ceasefire that began early Tuesday to allow food and medicine deliveries to the Russian‑occupied city of Oleshky has been broadened to cover the larger Kherson region, officials said. Several thousand residents of Oleshky remain without electricity, food or water, and all road routes out are considered unsafe. No violations of the truce have been reported so far.
